predecessor_note: First release of this project. The delta below is the whole reachable history, 5243c89 to the release commit.

excluded_scope.reason: Both Z80 driver images are copied verbatim and never disassembled. They are executable code inside binary assets, which the source boundary rule otherwise forbids, so the exclusion is named here rather than left implicit.
excluded_scope.control: Both images are hash-pinned in assets/manifest.json, owned by a named module, and their ROM ranges are declared in config/rom_layout.json.

excluded_scope.reason: Eight of seventeen extracted segments round-trip byte for byte. The six Nemesis segments round-trip only semantically, and Enigma has no encoder.
excluded_scope.control: config/data_formats.json declares the weaker claim per segment and make roundtrip-formats enforces exactly the claim declared.

excluded_scope.reason: The runtime layer checks work RAM, not pixels. Screenshot comparison needs a reference capture from a known-good build, and none is tracked.
excluded_scope.control: validate_runtime_scenarios.py accepts --reference-dir and compares frames when one is supplied.

excluded_scope.reason: bin/linux_x86_64 is vendored and the Makefile autodetects it, but the gate has not been run on a Linux host, and make trace additionally needs a Windows emulator binary.
excluded_scope.control: config/toolchain.json records the Linux host as partial rather than supported.

excluded_scope.reason: Flicky on the Mega Drive has a single canonical image. There are no additional revisions or platform profiles to accept.
Editors and content tools belong to 2.0. 1.0 ships codecs only, and only for the formats it can round-trip.

delta.summary: make verify now compares against the cartridge dump. It never had: the previous reference was a copy of the project's own first build, which hid 73,045 bytes of wrong padding and a checksum verification replaced by a branch and three NOPs.
flicky.s became an index of 43 address-ordered modules under a 700-line cap; the ROM layout is the include order.
The existing style was codified and made enforceable, with a formatter whose edits must stay byte-neutral.

All 1,488 disassembler-generated identifiers replaced across 1,979 definitions, each recorded against its imported name. The RAM-resident jump table at $FFFA70 resolved against Sys_FuncTable, which names each trampoline by the procedure it reaches.
Subsystem map, memory map, naming and style contracts, and an unknowns registry with stable IDs linked in both directions from the source.
Decoders and encoders for the authored data formats, with a per-segment round-trip claim that make roundtrip-formats enforces at exactly the strength declared.
1,739 ROM symbols exported from the assembler listing, with breakpoint and watch configs resolved by name so a rename cannot orphan one silently.

Twelve scenarios replay the two recorded movies under the emulator and check 68 declared values of work RAM, resolved through src/memory/ram.inc. The layer found and corrected a naming defect in Demo_Init's round tables on its first run.
Toolchain hashes are verified before the assembler runs, the ROM layout became a checked contract instead of prose, and this manifest records the complete public release boundary.

The entrypoint moved from flicky.s at the repository root to src/main.s, the project's canonical source index, and its includes are now written relative to src/. The AS object and listing are named explicitly so the move does not drop build artifacts into src/.

The inline '; was:' markers became docs/provenance/label_renames.json, which maps all 1,717 imported labels to their current names and paths; the naming vocabulary in docs/naming.md is now enforced by make lint rather than only documented.

CODE-002 records the one defect class byte identity cannot see: an immediate the disassembler read as an address. A build with the padding removed is the check, and the current source passes it while the pre-reconstruction source reaches game over.

evidence.note: Byte-by-byte comparison against the cartridge dump, reporting the first differing offset. A hash alone is not accepted.
Vendored assembler, pinned padding byte, platform autodetect, and a toolchain check that runs before the assembler does.

Every binary asset has a named owner, a declared ROM range and a hash. The exception is the Z80 driver, which is executable code inside two blobs; it is excluded by name as z80_sound_driver_source rather than counted as satisfied.

Seven open questions with stable IDs, and a provenance table mapping every imported label to its current name. Every evidence tag except the plain observation tag names a registry entry, and every entry is referenced back; lint checks both directions and the table is held to the source in both.
98 unit tests over the formatter, the linters, the codecs, the state-dump reader, the symbol export and this audit.
The cartridge dump and every extracted payload stay untracked. release_audit.py walks all reachable git history, not just the worktree.
build/ is ignored and regenerated by the gate, so a stale local artifact cannot mask a regression.
Each claim carries its own level: static, byte identity, round trip or runtime. Segments that only round-trip semantically say so.

SHA-256 for every vendored binary and message catalog, checked before use. The emulator is pinned by upstream commit because it is cross-built locally and a MinGW PE is not reproducible byte for byte; the hash of the build that produced this release's captures is recorded.
One profile, direct coverage, 12 scenarios and 68 checked state expectations.

Annotated tag with a release summary, peeled to the release commit. The tag has never been published: git ls-remote --tags origin is empty, so the contract's unpublished-rewrite exception applies to its one move.
English titles and bodies, one architectural task per commit, and truthful attribution. Commits predating the adoption of this contract are listed in delta as they stand.

profiles.description: The single Mega Drive cartridge image. Flicky has no other accepted revision or platform in this release.

artifacts.note: Regenerated by the gate and never committed; it is byte-identical to the cartridge dump, so tracking it would track the game.

layout_deviations.reason: There is no linker: AS emits one object and p2bin flattens it, so there is no linker script to own the layout.
layout_deviations.equivalent_control: config/rom_layout.json declares the memory regions, the ROM landmarks, the padding gap and all 36 module ranges, and make verify-layout checks every one against the build.

layout_deviations.reason: Adopted; the decisions that were previously only in commit messages are recorded there.
layout_deviations.equivalent_control: Listed in required_documents and checked by release-audit.
